= Admonitions and Quotations

Each admonition label opens one paragraph:

NOTE: A note gives extra information.

TIP: A tip gives advice.

WARNING: A warning describes something that can go wrong.

IMPORTANT: An important point is easy to miss.

CAUTION: A caution asks the reader to take care.

The label must match exactly.

NOTES: this line is prose.

This line only mentions NOTE: in passing.

Admonitions can contain inline content:

TIP: Run `make test` before you push. Read
link:https://example.com/ci[the CI logs] when it fails.

A quotation line starts with `>` followed by a space:

> The first quoted line.
> The second quoted line.

A bare `>` separates paragraphs inside a quotation:

> First, the claim.
>
> Then, the qualification.
